additional_frontier.status: Credible unrated NNUE challenger. Native protocol issue from earlier attempt remains unresolved; no strength verdict admitted.
Current pinned source uses v0.5.0 NNUE. Exact startup-network loading and stderr compatibility must be validated before native scoring.

completion_case: Current frontier catalog is documented with pinned primary sources and explicit coverage limits.

The released or newly verified NGN build has complete admissible results against the rated leading Go families, including the missing Zahak benchmark at the primary longer clock. Clock dependence and confidence limits are explicitly assessed.

Credible unrated NNUE challengers are included in the conclusion; unresolved protocol failures do not count as chess wins. Confidence in top three must survive those challengers rather than silently excluding them.
The strongest measured Go challenger and remaining gap toward number one are identified. An evidence-based next optimization or GPU-training lane is selected if a gap remains.
compute_policy: All engine execution, builds, chess validation, scored matches and training run on WSL. Use the GPU for a justified NNUE experiment; no training launch merely to occupy the GPU.

current_evidence.admission: Complete, audited and independently recounted; no partial or stopped trials pooled.
Complete, audited and independently recounted; native exact compatibility mechanism was separately validated.

next_milestone.capacity: Admit only after physical Windows C free space is at least 30 GiB; retain ongoing 25 GiB guard.
next_milestone.fresh_controls: 12-game smoke followed by 128-game A/A with identical instrument, clock, concurrency and affinity. Exact plan and openings will be frozen before any new game.
next_milestone.opponent: Zahak 10.0, official unmodified Linux amd64 AVX release
next_milestone.verdict: Fixed completed cap only, all process/protocol/chess audits and independent recount must pass. Stopped, timed-out or capacity-failed trials remain unscored; no extension or pooling.

objective: Prove or improve NGN until the evidence supports confidence that an independent rating would place it among the top three Go chess-engine families; retain a measured route toward number one.

scope.language: Go/Golang engines; one best published version per family, with credible unrated NNUE releases included.
scope.primary_comparison: One physical CPU per engine, equal Hash128, native pinned opponents, same host and opening pairs, primary new clock 120+1.
scope.ranking_caution: CCRL does not publish a language-filtered world ranking. A shortlist derived from known Go families is conditional on catalog coverage. A head-to-head result is relative evidence and is not an official CCRL Elo or a transferable absolute rating. Multi-CPU results are a separate comparison.
